notes.title: Release version 1.0.7
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Revamp control system to adjust handling
[*]Remove cooldown time for aerial attacks
[*]Increase distance for aerial evasions
[*]Players can now easily chain evasions
[*]Introduce a brief input window before landing, allowing immediate actions like attacks
[*]Enhance skills of certain characters to balance abilities
[*]After unlocking cooperative characters, they can now be used in any story mode stage

[*] Added Steam Remote Play feature, allowing players to connect and battle against other players during duels.
[/list]

Once again, we apologize for the delay. We are continuing to refine the handling.
